chunks.head: strike out
chunks.note: strike out = 动身、奋力朝某方向前进(此处指下水奋力游向对岸);另有 strike out on one's own = 独自去闯。
chunks.ex_en: He struck out across the field toward the hills.
chunks.ex_cn: 他朝着山丘穿过田野走去。

chunks.head: no end of
chunks.note: no end of sth = 许许多多、无数(强调数量多)。
chunks.ex_en: We had no end of trouble finding the house.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们找那栋房子费了好大的劲。

chunks.head: just in time
chunks.note: just in time = 刚好赶上、险些来不及。
chunks.ex_en: We reached the station just in time to catch the train.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们正好赶到车站坐上了火车。

chunks.head: take care of
chunks.note: take care of sb/sth = 照顾、照料;也可指'处理、搞定某事'。
chunks.ex_en: She takes care of her little brother after school.

chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(give him up),故 card-only。give up sb/sth = 放弃、割舍。

chunks.head: under one's nose
chunks.note: right under one's nose = 就在某人眼前(却没被注意到)。
chunks.ex_en: The keys were right under my nose the whole time.
chunks.ex_cn: 钥匙一直就在我眼皮底下。

chunks.head: from time to time
chunks.note: from time to time = 不时地、偶尔。
chunks.ex_en: From time to time she visits her grandparents.
chunks.ex_cn: 她时不时去看望祖父母。

chunks.head: put in a word for
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(put in a kindly word for),故 card-only。put in a (good) word for sb = 替某人美言、说情。
chunks.ex_en: Could you put in a good word for me with the boss?
chunks.ex_cn: 你能在老板面前替我美言几句吗?

chunks.head: break down
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(broke entirely down),故 card-only。break down = 情绪崩溃痛哭;也指机器'出故障'。
chunks.ex_en: She broke down and cried when she heard the news.

chunks.head: turn up
chunks.note: turn up = (人或失物)出现、露面;也指把音量'调大'。
chunks.ex_en: He finally turned up an hour late.
chunks.ex_cn: 他终于露面了,迟到了一个小时。

chunks.head: occur to sb
chunks.note: it occurs to sb that… = 某人突然想到某事。
chunks.ex_en: It suddenly occurred to me that I had left the door open.

chunks.head: thread one's way
chunks.note: thread one's way through/back = 小心地在人群或障碍间穿行。
chunks.ex_en: She threaded her way through the busy market.
chunks.ex_cn: 她在拥挤的市场里穿行。

chunks.head: turn in
chunks.note: turn in = 上床睡觉(口语);另有'上交'义。
chunks.ex_en: I'm tired, so I'll turn in early tonight.

chunks.head: on board
chunks.note: on board = 在船(或车、飞机)上;also go on board = 上船。
chunks.ex_en: All the passengers are already on board the ship.

chunks.head: broad daylight
chunks.note: in broad daylight = 光天化日之下(常强调明目张胆)。
chunks.ex_en: The thief broke in in broad daylight.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷光天化日之下闯了进来。

chunks.head: be up to something
chunks.note: be up to something = 在偷偷做某事,常含'搞鬼、耍花招'之意。
chunks.ex_en: The children are very quiet—they must be up to something.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们特别安静,肯定在搞什么鬼。

chunks.head: set to work
chunks.note: set to work = 开始干活、着手做事。
chunks.ex_en: After breakfast they set to work in the garden.
chunks.ex_cn: 早饭后他们开始在花园里干活。
